subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat omission or disabled scheduler state when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the durable fix changes how cron scheduling interacts with explicit per-agent heartbeat configuration, which is a compatibility policy choice for existing users.

options.title: Accept cron-owned wake override after proof
options.body: Require redacted real cron-run proof, then allow cron-owned wakes to bypass per-agent scheduler omission while keeping the global disable gate authoritative.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: Treat skipped/disabled as the intended result when an agent is omitted from heartbeat scheduling and update cron behavior/docs to avoid silent event removal.

options.title: Resolve mixed heartbeat defaults first
options.body: Defer this issue behind the broader heartbeat defaults contract tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78713.

recommendation.title: Accept cron-owned wake override after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real cron-run proof, then allow cron-owned wakes to bypass per-agent scheduler omission while keeping the global disable gate authoritative.
